title: ISSN Position Stand: Nutritional Considerations for Single-Stage Ultra-Marathon Training and Racing
publisher: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
claims: During ultra-marathon racing, runners should aim for 150–400 kcal per hour, with carbohydrate 30–50 g per hour and protein 5–10 g per hour, chosen for palatability and individual gut tolerance.
Fluid volumes of 450–750 mL per hour (about 150–250 mL every 20 minutes) are recommended during racing; electrolyte needs rise in hot and humid conditions.
Carbohydrate intake tolerance varies widely, and high intake or hyperosmolar solutions are a primary nutritional cause of gastrointestinal distress during racing.
